name: Crocodile
publication: Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement
sourceComparison: The local and official version-1 have different file hashes and matching extracted text on pp. 7–9.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s adventure errata lists no change to this Crocodile stat block.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the already selected original portrait. The supplement does not describe the pictured animal’s appearance.
habitatEvidence: Editorial encounters based on ordinary crocodile habitat and the source’s swim speed. The supplement gives no habitat list.
mechanicsNotes: Bite targets one creature and the scoped block adds no size restriction to its grapple.
Grapple escape uses ordinary 2014 rules for monster attacks.
